title: Unreal Full Ai Coding
author: Dramatic_Honeydew_86
selftext:
I don't know an ounce of coding. Although slowly learning to a very small degree.

But I am making full on first person shooter roguelikes, coop games the work perfectly and so many crazy types of games I could never have imagined making.

Honestly, my problem... is too many ideas, and now that we can make them reality. I seem to struggle locking in on one idea. I have 5 or 6 fairly good games almost ready to release with no help in marketing and some UI changes. They may just sit there, because that is the only thing stopping them for mild to big success. I can put them out there without a chance.

AI is unbelievable. 2 years from now, more people will find out and there will be an unbelievable amount of average to good games.

comments.author: Szabe442
comments.body: Really curious about these 5 or 6 fairly good games you did with no coding.

replies.author: Puntley
replies.body: You wouldn't have heard of them, they go to a different school.

comments.author: Benhamish-WH-Allen
comments.body: I would take one decent isometric roguelike.

comments.author: demianxyz
comments.body: Share some videos/screenshots we are curious!

comments.author: Puntley
comments.body: I know what you mean, man. Every night I'm cranking out another triple A hit. Halo re-remasterer? That was me. Black ops 6? Took me an afternoon. Happy feet for the Nintendo Wii? Believe it or not, me.

replies.author: preytowolves
replies.body: halo remaster was you? man good job on that one. must have been a hello of a prompt.

replies.author: Puntley
replies.body: Yeah. It was actually chatGPTs idea, it told me it was tired of making the easy shit like Minecraft 2 and half-life 3 and wanted a real challenge. I asked ChadGPT "but what if you miss?" And it just said "I won't." And banged it out on the first try.

comments.author: ivanoski-007
comments.body: You sound like an insufferable "ideas" guy who solves the world after a few drinks but never does anything

comments.author: IncorrectAddress
comments.body:
Yeah, I don't disagree with the pace of AI, great games will come from great designers (classical designers), because they will have the power to make things without requiring a lot of money to create something.

It's going to be an interesting time in the gaming sector.
